1.en: I swear by this city, Makkah -

2.en: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -

3.en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

4.en: We have certainly created man into hardship.

5.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
5.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

6.en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

7.en: Does he think that no one has seen him?

8.en: Have We not made for him two eyes?

9.en: And a tongue and two lips?

10.en: And have shown him the two ways?

11.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

12.en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

13.en: It is the freeing of a slave

14.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
14.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

16.en: Or a needy person in misery

17.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
17.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

18.en: Those are the companions of the right.

19.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
19.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

20.en: Over them will be fire closed in.
